title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, University of Oregon on 1969-05-31
lineage: Transfer info: Tascam DA-302 > Sound Devices 722 (digital transfer)
taper: Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear)
source: Bear’s Ampex cassette (or possibly reel) SBD master > DAT (provided by Anon)

ai_review.summary: Stunning 1969 show highlighted by an epic Baby Blue and definitive Friend of Mine, captured on a soundboard transfer that suffers from noticeable hiss.
ai_review.review: The performance is universally praised – the whole concert is described as stunning with Baby Blue soaring and Friend of Mine delivered as a definitive version. The soundboard source provides a clear picture of the band, though one reviewer notes added hiss compared to earlier transfers, making the audio quality only fair.

ai_rating.rationale: High praise for musical performance (≈4.8) offset by a consistent complaint about hiss in the recording (≈3.5); weighted average yields ~4.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Increased hiss compared to earlier transfers; some loss of warmth, but overall still listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Cohesive and high‑energy set that flows naturally, delivering psychedelic peaks throughout.
